notes: Normalized from a noisy probe. Type sizes rounded from sub-pixel values (23.51→1.47rem body, 13.22→0.8rem label, 39.67→2.5rem, 52.90→3.3rem); the hero condensed display ('te-40') runs far larger than any captured size (poster scale, likely SVG/oversized lockup) — recorded as 'poster'. Grid gap normalized 11.75→12px; block padding 33/66→32/64px. Weights skew light (300 dominant, 100 common); the heavy hero is the contrast. Orange (~#FF6600) appears only inside imagery/SVG (EP tag, illustration, product knobs), not as a computed UI token — kept under roles.art_orange as art-direction, not a system color. No shadows, no gradients in computed styles. Radius is sharp by default (0) with full pills (52.90px → 9999px) for buttons/country selector only. Motion is minimal and reduced-motion-aware; no IntersectionObserver, GSAP, or Lenis.
